title: Migrate character creation off SRD_CATALOG and retire the legacy SRD catalog
description: ADR 0013 / eshyra-t2ra retired the DND5E_SRD_RULES_PACK placeholder and made the importer-generated pack the runtime rules truth. The legacy hand-authored SRD catalog (packages/core/src/rules/srd/: data.ts SRD_CATALOG, store.ts lookupSrdRecord, types.ts) survives ONLY because packages/core/src/character/creation.ts still validates D&D class/spell drafts against it via lookupSrdRecord/SRD_CATALOG. ADR 0013 gates SRD_CATALOG deletion on 'nothing depends on them', so it could not be removed in t2ra. Migrate character creation to resolve against the runtime generated pack (getBundledDnd5eSrdPack + lookupRulesRecord), then delete srd/ and its internal exports. Note this overlaps eshyra-4jiu (guided session-zero character flow) — coordinate or fold in.
notes: Folded into eshyra-b69j.3 / PR #283 — SRD_CATALOG and rules/srd/ deleted, character creation migrated to generated pack. Close on merge.
